scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=server && npm test --workspace=client && tsx scripts/roleTimer.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.stop: lsof -ti tcp:3001 -ti tcp:5173 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; echo 'overwatch dev servers stopped'
